source_identity.aipackage_access: Official versioned web text inspected 2026-10-01; no byte digest claimed for web-reader output.

scope: Four represented AI Profile propositions: two licence relationships, inherited required AIPackage fields and optional AI properties.
excluded_material: Other SPDX profiles/relationships and every optional property as a separate governance duty.
Licence conformance as proof of legal permission.

entries.source_comparison: AI Profile states exactly one hasConcludedLicense /Core/Relationship from every AIPackage to /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo. Endpoint types/cardinality are preserved in structured artefacts and verification, even though the readable summary is shorter.
entries.current_summary: Every AI package must be the from-element of exactly one hasConcludedLicense relationship.
entries.metadata_review: All eight scope/output dimensions compared to versioned class/conformance tables; existing explicit inherited fields, relationship endpoint types, optional property conditions and voluntary conformance qualifications retained.
entries.semantic_coherence_review: One independent conformance proposition or one informative optional-property description; no maximal-verb splitting.

reverse_coverage.rationale: Typed license endpoints support local metadata binding, not proof of licence validity or workflow-wide authority preservation.

entries.source_comparison: AI-specific properties have minCount zero. Their source-defined types/maxCounts constrain supplied values, but energy, safety, standards-compliance and explainability information is optional. No source mandate to perform all assessments is inferred.
entries.current_summary: An AI package may record AI-specific information including autonomy, domain, energy consumption, hyperparameters, training and application information, limitations, metrics and thresholds, preprocessing, explainability, safety risk assessment, standards compliance, model type and use of sensitive personal information.
